proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9051 phala explicitly gives Oriya phaḷa, Bastar phara and Gujarati/Marathi phaḷ fruit. Oriya pʰolo, Halbi pʰor and Bhilali phoḷə fit the regional fruit family with o/a and lateral/rhotic correspondences retained; the dictionary itself notes deeper Dravidian comparisons and a possible connection with phulla without settling them. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: phoḷə.
